sources.Blanc : coordonnées et ligne au sol · Ve: White: coordinates and ground line · Green: configured image anchor · Orange: horizontal centre of visible rectangle (including shadow, not a native pivot).
sources.Essai local : modèle gris légèrement à d: Local test: grey model slightly right and lower
sources.Exemples fictifs uniquement · mêmes imag: Fictitious examples only · the same images and drawing engine as the atlas. No collection, account or emulator.
sources.Par défaut : un gris entre deux bleus, Y: By default: one grey example between two blue examples, Y=600 for all three and X=598, 600, 602. Their 2×2 footprints touch with no empty tile; images can overlap. The same-Y line appears slanted in the illustrated view. The grey adjustment (+12px source right, +16px down) changes this simulation only, never the atlas.
sources.Survol piloté par le réglage ci-dessus,: Hover is controlled by the setting above, not the mouse. Pan and touch zoom are available; “Reset” recentres scenes. On phones, scroll a scene horizontally to keep all three buildings at their test size.

sources.Collection locale des images originales: Local collection of original images recovered from Kingshot files.
sources.Le Château Royal détaillé et les texture: The detailed Royal Castle and textures extracted from game files, with no added shield or invented pixels. A raw texture is not necessarily a ready-to-place building image.
Files remain local. Collection exports use only pixels from independently decoded UnityFS blocks. For the Royal Castle, encoding is corroborated by stream size, silhouette and a second ASTC version of the game; the native-format field remains damaged. The 26 excluded rows are transparent margin in that second version. Pivots, materials, animations and 3D assemblies are not all established. Technical reports and original Unity files remain in the project’s analysis folder, outside the site.
sources.Métadonnées et pixels dans des blocs ind: Metadata and pixels are in independent blocks. Full-image Sprite link corroborated.
Metadata and pixels are in independent blocks. Not an assembled scene: slicing, materials and placement remain separate.
sources.Pixels tous connus. Projection calibrée: All pixels are known. Projection calibrated on all four bases; native shaders and transforms are not reproduced.
sources.Silhouette complète, roche et cascade. 2: Complete silhouette, rock and waterfall. 26 transparent-margin rows excluded; native pivot and assembly are not established.
sources.Noms des QG même en dézoom: HQ names even when zoomed out

sources.Rectangles = empreintes des objets reçus: Rectangles are received object footprints. X,Y is the minimum corner; the light point is the anchor. The hovered or tapped cell is white. Names appear on hover, tap or click; X/Y cells appear when zoomed in.
sources.« Tout afficher » retire tous les filtre: “Show all” removes every filter. Type shortcuts combine with search and alliance.
sources.Arsenal, Mobilisation, Confrontation et: Arsenal, Mobilization, Confrontation and safe mines use 13 original interface logos recovered from the cache (ASTC format inferred, source pixels known). Variants follow level or resource when that data is known. Level is missing from the current snapshot of honour buildings: a base logo is shown with a notice. Banquets and tables still have no recovered original visual.
sources.Atlas local du royaume 690 : joueurs, al: Local Atlas of Kingdom 690: Players, Alliances and Kingshot Buildings.
sources.Aucune action de jeu n’est envoyée. Pas: No in-game action is sent. There is no automatic collection or repeated attempt after a refusal. The current snapshot stays available.
sources.Ce test vérifie une identité Google dest: This test verifies a Google identity intended for
sources.Cette action lit les 400 zones puis les: This action reads all 400 zones, then the detailed area around HQs (bear traps and other buildings). It takes about 8–10 minutes. Your game may disconnect.
sources.Le fond reconstruit utilise la géographi: The reconstructed background uses the 1200 × 1200 mask geography and colours measured in your game captures: grass, water and shores. It is not a recovered native texture. Terrain remains illustrative, and original tree/rock positions are not established.
sources.Le site reste local : accès Wi-Fi en lec: The site remains local: Wi-Fi access is read-only when enabled, while refresh is reserved for the Mac through 127.0.0.1. There is no publication or external analysis tool. Authentication files are never served.
sources.Les quatre gisements utilisent maintenan: The four deposits now use their game visuals (mill/farm, sawmill, quarry, foundry) on the map, in results and panels. Their source pixels are verified; some reconstructed metadata fields are documented in provenance. Flags, bear traps and some castles also use recovered sprites. Missing skins remain illustrative; the HQ sprite assignment is inferred.
sources.Positions lues sur le serveur pour votre: Positions read from the server for kingdom 690. This is a sequential snapshot, not real-time tracking; only objects visible in responses are known.
sources.Tous les bâtiments reçus sont conservés,: Every received building is retained, including unowned deposits. Known abbreviations are shared between objects of the same alliance through its identifier and precede the player name. The full alliance name is not recovered.
sources.Vue de carte : 2D illustrée ou plan de d: Map view: 2D illustrated or top plan
sources.Vue de dessus · empreintes sur la grille: Top view · fingerprints on the grid
sources.contours extérieurs des zones 8/9 du mas: outer outlines of zones 8/9 in the original mask, shown on both backgrounds. Their colour is explanatory, not a recovered native shader. Mask 9 is statically prohibited; mask 8 corresponds to special site areas and is not globally prohibited for teleports. Territory and protection states are unknown.
sources.le masque original est identique au fich: the original mask is identical to the file recovered with REA from the emulator cache. The layer identifies static exclusions and the checker examines a castle’s full 2×2 footprint. No exclusion is not authorization: occupation, additional terrain, fog, player/alliance/war conditions and server validation remain unknown. No teleport is sent.
sources.les 400 zones sont lues au LOD 1 pour le: All 400 zones are read at LOD 1 for castles, flags, HQs and deposits. A LOD 0 read of small areas around HQs finds bear traps and other alliance buildings. These may be absent when far from an HQ: this is not an exhaustive inventory.
sources.les gisements d’alliance (type 35) produ: alliance deposits (type 35) produce resources for the alliance. Safe mines (type 39) are alliance-built gathering centres. They are distinct categories. Standard resources (type 2) are not currently exported.
sources.l’onglet montre seulement les joueurs do: the tab only shows players whose known origin kingdom differs from 690. Their origin does not prove hostility; an unknown origin is excluded, never guessed. Results describe the snapshot, not current presence.
sources.rectangles orthogonaux aux dimensions de: orthogonal rectangles use the game configuration dimensions, with no artificial sprite size. X,Y indicates the minimum-coordinate corner; a 2×2 castle at X676/Y402 covers X676–677 and Y402–403. Ranges appear in the panel and selected object cells when zoomed in. Territory/protection zones are not its footprint. An unknown size remains marked as such. The snapshot establishes neither complete current occupancy nor placement authorization.
sources.sept logos de mini-carte sont extraits d: seven mini-map logos were extracted from the game cache: central castle, four shrines, medium fort and tower. Their source pixels are known; the texture format and offsets of two logos are inferred, as stated in provenance. The major-fort logo remains unrecovered and is not replaced with another building. These are not native 3D models.
sources.sont conservés. Les fonds natifs n’étant: are retained. Since native backgrounds were not recovered, displayed colours are a local per-alliance palette editable in a panel. They do not claim to reproduce the game’s exact colour.
sources.« Envahisseurs » désigne ici les joueurs: “Invaders” means players whose origin is outside this kingdom; it does not assume hostility. Unknown origins are excluded.
